_comment: Stage 8 retrieval-quality fixtures. Expected chunks are keyed by headingPath + position, never documentId (a fresh document id is assigned on every upload/run). These values were generated by actually running chunkMarkdown() against sample-policy.md, not guessed - the real chunker merges several H3 subsections together (see docs/learning-notes.md's Stage 8 entry), so several distinct questions below correctly point at the SAME chunk. expectedChunks: [] means the question is negative - the policy has no answer, and the grader expects nothing relevant to be returned.
